subject: general
question: Praveen is offering a 10% discount on all clothes to sell the stock as early as possible. One of his friends, Vijay, came to the shop and purchased one coat. Because of their friendship, Praveen gave an additional 6% discount to Vijay. What was the price of the coat if Vijay paid Rs. 7,614?
solution:
**Given:**

Praveen is offering a 10% discount on all clothes to sell the stock as early as possible. He gave an additional 6% discount to Vijay at a price of Rs. 7614.

**Formula used:**

Discount price = (1 - discount ratio) × cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the coat be x.

Then, (94)/(100)× (90)/(100)× x=7614

Solving for x,

(7614)/(0.9×0.94) =9000

**∴ The cost price of the cost is Rs. 9000.**
